entities.summary: Scott David Radinsky is an American left-handed former relief pitcher in Major League Baseball, who had an 11-year career from 1990–1993 and 1995–2001. Radinsky is also the lead singer of the punk rock band Pulley, former lead singer of the band Ten Foot Pole and co-owner of the skate park which houses the Skateboarding Hall of Fame.
